appContext.summary: An alarm clock you can't snooze your way out of. Each alarm rings until you prove you're awake: type a phrase you chose, or answer quick math and trivia questions. The volume stays locked at max until you solve it, and an optional wake-up check-in asks 'Are you awake?' a few minutes later, ringing again if you went back to sleep. Alarms are real system alarms with automatic backups. Alarmed Pro is a weekly, monthly or yearly subscription. Audience: heavy sleepers, students with early lectures, gym-goers. Style: dark night-sky, near-black #0A0A0C canvas with a single confident electric blue accent #4F83FF, bold short headlines, calm and premium, no clutter.

theme.style: A deep pre-dawn night sky on a near-black #0A0A0C canvas, lit by a single confident electric blue (#4F83FF) glow like the first cold light before sunrise. The mood is calm, quiet and premium, with soft volumetric haze, faint star dust, smooth glassy gradients and subtle film grain. Backgrounds stay restrained, with one luminous blue focal element per slide and the upper area left dark and open for bold white headlines.
